apis.name: malloc
apis.invalid: size overflow impl-defined; allocator failure NULL

apis.name: realloc
apis.ownership: on success transfers; on failure preserves old
apis.invalid: NULL ptr acts as malloc; bytes 0 impl-defined

apis.name: printf_s
apis.invalid: non-literal format or %n triggers runtime violation (exit 70 / EINVAL)

apis.name: fprintf_s
apis.bounds: non-null stream; literal format required (CWE-134); forbids %n
apis.invalid: null stream/format, non-literal format, or %n rejected

apis.name: snprintf_s
apis.bounds: dmax <= dest capacity; literal format required (CWE-134); forbids %n
apis.invalid: dmax overflow, UAF, non-literal format, or %n triggers runtime violation

apis.name: sprintf_s
apis.bounds: dmax <= dest capacity; literal format required (CWE-134); forbids %n
apis.invalid: dmax overflow, UAF, non-literal format, or %n triggers runtime violation

apis.name: scanf_s
apis.bounds: literal format required (CWE-134); %s/%[ require field width (CWE-120); forbids %n
apis.invalid: non-literal format, unbounded %s/%[, or %n triggers runtime violation
apis.errors: EINVAL on invalid/violation, EOF on input end

apis.name: fscanf_s
apis.bounds: non-null stream; literal format required (CWE-134); %s/%[ require field width (CWE-120); forbids %n
apis.invalid: null stream/format, non-literal format, unbounded %s/%[, or %n rejected
apis.errors: EINVAL on invalid/violation, EOF on input end

apis.name: sscanf_s
apis.bounds: non-null str; literal format required (CWE-134); %s/%[ require field width (CWE-120); forbids %n
apis.invalid: null/UAF str or format, non-literal format, unbounded %s/%[, or %n rejected
apis.errors: EINVAL on invalid/violation, EOF on input end
